operating_point.sizes_and_parameters: MIME's 338-point MRS sphere, a = 0.7 mm, density of the fluid 1260 kg/m^3; a periodic coarse box of 24^3 cells of 140 um with a solid slab 4 cells thick (a plane wall below the sphere, another 1.2 mm above it); the fine cell 70 um (10 fine cells across the radius, ratio 2), the patch the sphere plus 8 fine cells a side (36^3); the sphere's surface 0.3 a and 0.15 a above the wall, held in place, given an impulsive velocity along the wall's normal and along the wall at t = 0; stage 1's corners: mu 50 and 200 mPa s, dt 0.5 and 5 ms, so lambda = a / sqrt(nu dt) = 4.9, 1.6, 2.5, 0.78 (the 1.69 mm sphere's 6.0 is the first's at a = 0.845 mm, not run separately); 40 steps an arm or until the force settles to 1e-4

gate_10_in_time.claim: in F5's structure (per step: GMRES over the near field's forces under the step operator, the base column carrying the history), the backward-Euler patch with state follows the fine monolithic BE reference's force history after an impulsive start; the quasi-steady patch (shift zero, no history) is a declared opt-in only where its transient excess stays within the patch's own steady error at every stage-1 corner
gate_10_in_time.kind: estimates (each form against the fine monolithic reference: the whole box at the fine cell, the walled BE step and the own box at the fine cell, no patch)
gate_10_in_time.case: tests/patch/time_cases.py: arms reference, be_patch, quasi_steady_patch, coarse_only at the four corners and two gaps, normal and along the wall

prediction.unit: the BE patch's transient excess over its own steady error, max over steps of |e(t) - e(final)|, e = F_form / F_reference - 1, at every corner; the quasi-steady patch's excess 0.1 to 0.4 of the wall's share of the force in the first steps at lambda 2.5 and 4.9, and within 0.02 at lambda 0.78
prediction.why: under the step operator the reflection is screened beyond sqrt(nu dt) = a / lambda; a quasi-steady patch hands back the unscreened steady reflection inside the box at every step, so it over-states the wall's share until the reflection's diffusion time a^2 / nu = lambda^2 dt has passed; at lambda 0.78 that is under one step

gate_10_in_time.metric: e(t) for each form against the reference, and its excess over e(final); the quasi-steady's excess over the BE patch's, against the patch's steady error at 20 fine cells (gate 1's share at the same gap in fine cells)

control.plant: the BE patch with the snap's uncovered slab left unfilled (zero) and the sphere moved one fine cell a step along the wall, so every step snaps
control.expected_rate: the force history departs from the filled one by more than 1 % at every snapping step, every run (deterministic)
control.resolution: the slab's share of the reflection at the sphere, about the box's margin over its size [guess]

gate_10_in_time.if_wrong: the BE patch's excess beyond 5 %: the history's own-field part (the own box's history at the shell) or the slab fill is wrong; read it arm by arm, the history's near-body error first (the interface's point 2: that number goes in the validity line)
gate_10_in_time.cannot_discriminate_if: lambda under about 0.5 (both forms then agree by construction) or the force settles in one step

item_3_history_error.claim: the own field's history taken from the coarse own box (the interface's (b)) moves the BE patch's force from the reference's by a stated amount near the body
item_3_history_error.prediction: at 0.15 a and lambda 4.9: within 3 % of the reference's force at every step after the first (band 0.5 to 6 %); at lambda 0.78 within 1 %
item_3_history_error.basis: guess: the history is smoothed over a / lambda, at 4.9 under two coarse cells at ratio 2
